blind_spots.blind_spot: Product identity is 'native Microsoft Teams' — but DoD/USCG Teams lives in GCC High / IL4-IL5 tenants with STIG'd clients, and a commercial-tenant-native integration cannot follow the customer onto accredited networks.
blind_spots.operator_reality: The Coast Guard incident commander's workstation is on an accredited network; the PRATUS-Teams integration either passes RMF inside that boundary or the tool stays on someone's personal laptop outside the command post.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Company grew from commercial/state emergency management where a Microsoft Premier Partner badge sells; site never mentions ATO, RMF, IL levels, or FedRAMP despite courting national-level operations.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Built natively into the Microsoft ecosystem, including Teams, PRATUS unifies data, decisions, and people in one secure platform

blind_spots.blind_spot: Every capability claim ('live weather data', 'near-instant situational awareness', 'real-time insights') presumes cloud connectivity — yet disaster response and military operations are the canonical DDIL environments where comms fail first.
blind_spots.operator_reality: In the first 72 hours of a hurricane or at an austere staging site, cell and broadband are down; a cloud-SaaS 'one pane of glass' becomes zero panes of glass with no stated offline or sync-on-reconnect mode — same failure mode as the 30fps crowd-detection case.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Platform architecture is Azure/Teams SaaS; offline-first was never a design constraint for tabletop-exercise and EOC customers on good networks.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: PRATUS integrates live weather data, critical infrastructure impact models, and AI-powered analytics to give you near-instant situational awareness.

blind_spots.blind_spot: The STTR Phase II builds an AI/optimization decision-support system for humanitarian operations with no stated path from research model to accredited, sustained fielding — the classic Phase II-to-fielded gap.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A strategic-planning optimization model that can't get onto the operational network before the period of performance ends becomes a demo; the advocacy chain above the exercise-planner level is nowhere in their language.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Abstract is written in research deliverable terms ('deploy an optimization model and an artificial intelligence (AI)-based solution approach'), not transition terms — no sponsor org, no target network, no accreditation plan mentioned.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: The proposed decision support system will deploy an optimization model and an artificial intelligence (AI)-based solution approach

opener_hook: PRATUS is built natively into commercial Microsoft Teams, yet its Coast Guard and USAF STTR work lands on IL4+ networks where that tenant integration cannot follow without an RMF path the site never mentions.
what_they_do: Cloud SaaS incident-management and AI decision-support platform embedded in Microsoft Teams for emergency and military planning, operations, and training exercises.
